The Short Form-36 Version 2 Health Survey acute form (SF-36v2 acute), 1-week recall version is a 36-item generic, participant-administered measure designed to assess the following 8 domains:
The Physical Functioning domain assesses limitations due to health “now” while the remaining domains assess functioning “in the past week.”
Items are answered on Likert scales of varying lengths (3-point, 5-point, or 6-point scales).

Scoring of each domain and both summary scores are norm based and presented in the form of T-scores, with a mean of 50 and standard deviation of 10; higher scores indicate better levels of function and/or better health
2 health component summary scores: Physical Component Summary and Mental Component Summary.
Preferred administration order of these questionnaires is 1. PGIS for Physical Activity 2. SF-36 v2 acute form, and 3. IWQOL-Lite CT.

A 5-item subset of the Physical domain – the Physical Function composite – is also supported.
All items are rated on either a 5-point frequency (“never” to “always”) scale or a 5-point truth (“not at all true” to “completely true”) scale.
